{{recipe}}

This dish is perfect for your next dinner party. To reheat, place in an aluminum foil pouch and warm in a 200 °F [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]].

== Ingredients ==
*1 block (10 ounces) [[Cookbook:Brie Cheese|Brie cheese]], rind removed and brought to room temperature
*1 sheet [[Cookbook:Puff Pastry|puff pastry]], thawed
*1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]], beaten
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] salt
*1 tsp freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]

== Procedure ==
#Place block of cheese in the middle of sheet of pastry.
#Trim off about ½ inch of pastry, and fold pastry over cheese. When you reach the last fold, brush the fold with beaten egg to seal the pastry together.
#Brush top with egg and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] at 375 °F for 15 minutes.
#Cool 10 minutes and serve.
